answer_1.quote: The tasks include code summarization, which requires the model to concisely summarize the core functionality and intent of the code... The code review generation task is a sequence generation task that generates comments or suggestions for code changes that need improvement.
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions of code functionality and review comments

answer_2.quote: We employ four commonly used metrics, BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE, and BERTScore for evaluating code summarization... We use three metrics to measure the quality of test cases generated by LLMs: pass rate, line coverage, and branch coverage... We adopt the execution-based metric Pass@k.
